name: ollaya
summary: Jev-compatible API server for open decision models. Ollama for decision models: pull and serve 25 model families (Laya, pplx-decider, Clef, Winnow, coba...) locally or self-hosted behind /v1/systemone. The TypeSafe SDK works unchanged: set its base URL and pick an open model. CLI, desktop app, Docke
